semiconductor_relevance: Medium — VDM Metals Korea specializes in high-performance materials that can be utilized in semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: VDM Metals Korea manufactures high-performance alloys such as nickel, cobalt, and zirconium, which are essential for various semiconductor applications. They also provide specialized services including technical consulting and joint R&D for material development, enhancing their value in the semiconductor supply chain.

regional_presence.Korea: In 2016, VDM Metals opened a service center in the Gimje Free Trade Zone to support small-lot and urgent orders efficiently.
